d: A high-school senior drives cross-country with his best friends to hook up with a girl he met online.
A college senior hatches a plan to stay after he gets cut off while he charms a student trying to expose him.
A Puerto Rican family living in west Chicago face what may be their last Christmas together.
Jason Lee stars as a man who falls for his fiancée's cousin (Julia Stiles) just before his wedding.
